SavedResult.title: SavedResult
SavedResult.description: A customized task result generated by an AI agent and chosen by the user to be saved.

id.description: Unique identifier of the saved result.

title.description: User-defined or auto-generated title for the task process.

agentId.description: Key of the agent who executed the task.

prompt.description: The specific query/prompt sent to the agent.

result.description: The generated result text chosen and saved.

savedAt.description: Server timestamp when the result was saved.

userId.description: The Firebase User ID of the owner.

/saved_results/{resultId}.description: Collection of saved agent task results.
